findings.description: Both original and candidate numberLabel render ±Number.MAX_VALUE as ±Infinity because rounding to three significant digits overflows on conversion back to Number. The candidate does not regress this behavior; the 1206-case envelope stops at exponent 300.
findings.recommendation: A future generic formatter hardening can format the finite value without a rounding-to-Number overflow and add near-maximum finite tests. No arbitrary finite-value coverage is inferred here.

limits: Acceptance is isolated renderer/stylesheet presentation only. Shared owner handoff, exact prior-source/receipt preservation, possible rebase and actual installed main-application checks remain required.

Synthetic ordinary/empty/tiny/wide fixtures test presentation only, not model scientific accuracy, full ordinary application behavior or arbitrary domains. Existing axis-range overflow behavior at extreme inputs is unchanged.

Initial favicon 404 and npm DNS failure remain documented; no pristine-console claim. No build, material call, browser action, remote action, model approval or live-delivery review was performed by reviewer.
reasons: Exact app comparison confines changes to number formatting, atlas-chart class attachment and horizontal plot margins. axisRange, source values, measured points, event handlers and domain calculations are unchanged; stylesheet retains every prior byte before the appended common chart rule.
All full point objects from the four original hash-bound exports exactly equal the fixture data, including mixed-transition null rates. No solver or new trajectory is involved.
The pure formatter suite passes 1206 signed cases from exponents -300 through 300, preserves tiny nonzero signs and reproduces the old zero-loss witness.

Saved actual observations show 16 charts at 390px and 1280px, all candidate tick text inside the SVG, exact expected raw coordinates and unchanged data/domains; prior mobile has 13 clipped labels. Saved screenshots support the readability improvement.
scope: Exact isolated generic chart presentation candidate and saved browser evidence only; prospective shared installation remains separate.
